entities.summary: Vladimir Lazarevich Yevlanov, is a Russian politician who last served as member of the State Duma of the VII convocation from 2016 to 2021. A member of the United Russia party, he was member of the Committee on Economic Policy, Industry, Innovative Development and Entrepreneurship.
